authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) / State Council Gazette
title: 经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）— 汇发〔2020〕14号 (Current Account Foreign Exchange Business Guidelines, 2020 edition)
quote: Art. 54: 个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元。 Art. 59: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。 Art. 62: 个人不得以分拆等方式规避便利化额度管理及真实性管理。 Art. 65: 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外…（一）外汇账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理。
used_for: The controlling rule text for lawful CNY→USD conversion: who may convert, what documents are required, what the USD 50,000 quota does and does not cap, anti-splitting rule, and the remittance-out step.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration), State Council Decree No. 532
quote: Art. 5: 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。 Art. 12: 经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础。 Arts. 39–45: 逃汇 fine up to 30% of the amount (30%–100% if serious); 非法套汇 up to 30%; illegal carriage of cash warning + up to 20%; private/illegal FX trading up to 30% (30%–100% if serious). Art. 52(2): 境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人。
used_for: Legal-basis statement that current-account transfers are not restricted; penalty ceilings for unlawful routes; residency-based definition of a domestic vs non-domestic individual.

title: Administrative Rules on Individuals' Foreign Exchange, PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3
quote: Art. 3: “Full convertibility principle shall apply to individuals' foreign exchange business under the current account.” Art. 7: banks and individuals “must not evade limit administration by splitting large amount into small batches or tamper with authenticity administration by using fabricated commercial bills or vouchers.” Art. 9: “An individual's foreign exchange sales and domestic individual's foreign exchange purchases shall be imposed an annual limit.” Art. 13: “A non-domestic individual can convert legitimate renminbi income obtained in China under the current account into foreign exchange and remit abroad at a bank by showing valid identity documents and relevant documents.”
used_for: English-language official text of the same rules; confirms the annual limit is stated for FX sales and for DOMESTIC individual purchases, and that non-domestic individuals convert documented lawful income.

title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 (Provisional Measures on Sale/Payment of FX for Individuals' Outward Asset Transfers), effective 2004-12-01
quote: Art. 2: two categories only — 移民转移 (emigration transfer) and 继承转移 (inheritance transfer). Art. 6: 移民转移 must apply once for the whole amount; first remittance ≤ half, after 1 year ≤ half of the remainder, after 2 years the balance; total ≤ RMB 200,000 may be remitted in one go after approval. Art. 8: requires 中国户籍注销证明 and proof of settling abroad certified by a Chinese embassy/consulate, plus 税收证明或完税凭证. Art. 10: ≤ RMB 500,000 approved by the local SAFE branch; above that by SAFE headquarters. Art. 11: the bank must remit directly to the applicant's own account in the country of residence and may not pay out cash inside China.
used_for: The capital-account route: only emigration and inheritance transfers qualify; the documents each needs. Its Art. 6 instalment schedule and Art. 10 head-office threshold are quoted as published in 2004 and were removed in 2014 — see S17.

title: 携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法 (Provisional Measures on Carrying Foreign Currency Cash Across the Border), 汇发〔2003〕102号
quote: Art. 5: ≤ USD 5,000 equivalent outbound — no permit; USD 5,000–10,000 — bank-issued 携带证; > USD 10,000 — SAFE-branch 携带证. Art. 7: in principle no more than USD 10,000 equivalent in cash may be carried out. Art. 3: inbound cash over USD 5,000 must be declared in writing to Customs.
used_for: Cash-carrying limits on the China side (US side is S13).

title: 关于规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易的通知 (Notice on Regulating Large Overseas Cash Withdrawals by Bank Card), 汇发〔2017〕29号
quote: Art. 1: 本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币; exceeding the annual cap suspends overseas cash withdrawal for the current and following year. Art. 4: 外币卡由每卡每日不得超过等值1000美元调整为等值1万元人民币; 人民币卡每卡每日不得超过等值1万元人民币. Art. 7: effective 2018-01-01.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）: 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬如何购汇汇出？
quote: 答：根据…（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条规定，“境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇”。
used_for: Regulator's own Q&A applying Art. 59 to a foreign individual's salary: documents, at a bank, no quota stated.

title: 26 U.S.C. §988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
quote: (c)(1)(C)(i): “the disposition of any nonfunctional currency … shall be treated as a section 988 transaction”. (e)(2): for a personal transaction “no gain shall be recognized … by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired … before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.” (e)(3): “personal transaction” excludes transactions whose allocable expenses meet §162 (other than travel) or §212 (other than taxes).
used_for: Whether converting a personal CNY balance creates US tax: the $200 personal-transaction threshold and the business-expense carve-out.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table
quote: Maximum amounts for penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025: non-willful foreign financial agency transaction violation $16,536; willful violation $165,353; general willful BSA violation $71,545–$286,184.
used_for: FBAR penalty exposure figures. Amounts are inflation-adjusted annually; the last codified change on this page is 2025-01-17.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
locator: Who must file; When to file; Keeping records
quote: A U.S. person must file an FBAR to report a financial interest in, or signature authority over, at least one foreign financial account if “the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported.” Due April 15 with an automatic extension to October 15; filed with FinCEN, not with the return; records kept five years.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
quote: Specified individuals living in the US: unmarried/ MFS — more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year or more than $75,000 at any time during the year; MFJ — more than $100,000 / $150,000. Living outside the US: unmarried/ MFS — more than $200,000 / $300,000; MFJ — more than $400,000 / $600,000. Form 8938 penalties: “Up to $10,000 for failure to disclose and an additional $10,000 for each 30 days of non-filing after IRS notice …, for a potential maximum penalty of $60,000”.
used_for: Form 8938 thresholds and penalty range; distinguishes 8938 from FBAR.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
locator: China / Yuan row; “Translating foreign currency into U.S. dollars”
quote: “The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate. Generally, it accepts any posted exchange rate that is used consistently.” China (Yuan) yearly averages: 2025 — 7.129; 2024 — 7.189; 2023 — 7.075; 2022 — 6.730; 2021 — 6.452.
used_for: Which CNY/USD rates to use for reporting, and a documented history of rate movement for the §988 gain illustration.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
locator: Federal Mandate to Report Currency Exceeding $10,000
quote: “Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).” Filing is on FinCEN Form 105; for families/groups “the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual.”
used_for: US side of the cash-carrying route.

title: Tariff of Accounts and Services for Wealth and Personal Banking Business (effective 31 Oct 2026)
quote: 2.2.4.1 Telegraphic Transfer Issuance — Premier/Advance: “0.1% of remittance amount Min. CNY100 / equivalent per transaction Max. CNY500 / equivalent per transaction Plus Cable Charge”. 2.2.4.2 Cable Charges — Premier/Advance: “CNY120 / equivalent per cable”. Remark 1.1: “Pay Exact … CNY200 / equivalent will be collected from the remitter to cover the overseas bank charge”. 2.2.6.1 Global Transfer to self-name HSBC accounts — Premier free; Advance “CNY145 … actual charge per transaction will be USD20”. 2.2.7 International Education Payment — “CNY50 … actual charge … USD7”.
used_for: The only published, dated per-transfer fee schedule used in the cost model. A commercial bank tariff — not a regulator's rule — and it binds only HSBC China customers.

title: Overview of Bank of America Interest Checking key policies and fees (Clarity Statement)
locator: Additional fees table — Incoming wire transfers
quote: “Incoming wire transfers (each) … $16.00 — International wire transfer; other banks may charge additional fees.”
used_for: US receiving-bank fee in the model. One bank, one account type; other banks and accounts differ.

title: 中国银行外汇牌价 (Bank of China foreign exchange quotations)
quote: 美元: 现汇买入价 665.71 | 现钞买入价 665.71 | 现汇卖出价 668.51 | 现钞卖出价 668.51 | 中行折算价 671.67 (CNY per 100 USD).
used_for: A dated, published bid/ask snapshot used to measure the observable retail FX markup. Rates move continuously; this is a snapshot, not a quote for any transaction.

title: 国家外汇管理局关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知 (Notice on Further Improving and Adjusting Capital-Account Foreign Exchange Administration Policies), 汇发[2014]2号, dated 2014-01-10, in force 2014-02-10
locator: Section 六 (一)–(四); closing paragraph (in force 2014-02-10, earlier inconsistent rules yield); footnote on 汇发〔2023〕28号 (amends Section 三 only)
quote: 六、简化个人财产转移售付汇管理 （一）移民财产转移购付汇核准，由移民原户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。继承财产转移购付汇核准，由被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。取消财产转移总金额超过等值人民币50万元报国家外汇管理局备案的要求。（二）取消移民财产转移分次汇出的要求。申请人向原户籍所在地外汇局办理移民财产转移核准手续后，银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出相关资金。（三）取消继承人从不同被继承人处继承的财产应分别申请、分别汇出的要求。继承人从不同被继承人处继承财产，可选择其中一个被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局合并提交申请材料，经核准后可在银行一次或分次汇出相关资金。… 本通知自2014年2月10日起实施，以前规定与本通知不符的，以本通知为准。
used_for: Removes the 2004 instalment schedule for emigration transfers, the RMB 500,000 head-office step, and the rule that estates of different deceased persons be applied for separately. Routes R06 and R07.
